question.prompt: Name a popular American reality TV show.
question.criteria: Any U.S.-produced reality television series counts, including reality competitions and American editions of international formats; scripted series and conventional quiz shows do not.

answers.evidence: Survivor is a reality competition in which contestants compete while living in remote locations and vote one another out.
American Idol is an American singing competition television series.
The American edition of Big Brother follows contestants living together and competing to avoid eviction.
The Amazing Race is an American reality competition in which teams race between destinations and complete challenges.
The American edition of The Voice is a singing competition featuring celebrity coaches and blind auditions.
America's Got Talent is a televised competition featuring performers from a variety of disciplines.
Dancing with the Stars pairs celebrities with professional dancers for a televised dance competition.
RuPaul's Drag Race is an American reality competition featuring drag performers.
Top Chef is an American reality competition in which chefs complete culinary challenges.
Project Runway is an American reality competition featuring fashion designers.
Shark Tank is an American reality series in which entrepreneurs pitch businesses to investors.
The American edition of Hell's Kitchen is a cooking competition hosted by Gordon Ramsay.
The American edition of The Mole features contestants completing challenges while trying to identify a secret saboteur.
The Bachelor is an American reality dating competition.
The Bachelorette is an American reality dating competition spun off from The Bachelor.
The American edition of Kitchen Nightmares follows Gordon Ramsay as he works with struggling restaurants.
Pawn Stars is an American reality series centered on a Las Vegas pawn shop.
Below Deck is an American reality series following crew members working aboard a charter yacht.
Love Is Blind is a reality dating series in which participants initially meet without seeing each other.
Selling Sunset is an American reality series centered on a Los Angeles real estate brokerage.
American Ninja Warrior is a reality competition featuring elaborate obstacle courses.
Beauty and the Geek is an American reality competition that pairs contestants with contrasting social and academic strengths.
The Joe Schmo Show presents an elaborate staged reality show to an unsuspecting participant.
Solitary is an American reality competition in which contestants undertake challenges while separated into individual pods.
Pirate Master is an American pirate-themed reality competition set aboard a sailing ship.

question.explanation: American reality TV includes talent contests, survival competitions, dating shows, workplace series, and more. Shows adapted from international formats count when they have an American edition.
